CustomField.formula:
IF( OR(
OR( CONTAINS(Commercial_RM__c, $User.Account_Reporting_Branch__c), CONTAINS(Retail_RM__c,$User.Account_Reporting_Branch__c) ),
AND( $User.Reporting_Division__c = "CBG", OR( CONTAINS(Commercial_RM__c,"Business"), CONTAINS(Retail_RM__c,"Business") ) ),
$User.UserRoleName__c = "Retail Banking", CONTAINS($User.UserRoleName__c,"Region:") ),
TRUE, FALSE )
CustomField.label: User Match: Reporting
